en:
Until two years ago, when Deputy Commissioner Munakata of
Metropolitan Police was arrested for being involved in the
scam.

That brought the whole case back into the open. But this
time, the truth got out, and the bank's president was
arrested.

The authorities grilled me, too. But because all the
internal documents were destroyed after you were let go,
they didn't have enough to charge me.

Of course, the accusations alone were enough to end my
career at the bank.

So you left for Kansai, started your own financial
consulting firm, and here we are.

Unfortunately, I didn't have what it takes to run my own
business. Unlike you.

But you clearly haven't given up. Otherwise, you wouldn't
be looking for a loan.
Good. Now, to get back to business.

Do you or don't you want to borrow money from me? Let's
start there.

No. I won't. I don't have much left, but I still have my
pride.
Sorry to waste your time.

What are you going to do now? You won't get a loan from
anyone else in this town.
Who knows? Maybe I'll rob a bank.

Human beings will always try to survive, no matter how dire
the situation, just like you did when you were on the streets.
(Well, I can't say I expected him to take me up on my offer...)

(Still, no one else is going to grant him a loan. I doubt
he'd actually resort to robbing a bank, but... might want to
keep an eye on him.)
(Wow, lots of letters in these bags. I'll be sure to read and answer every last one of them.)
(Those pen names were so silly! Hehe!)
(Did they really think I wouldn't figure out their true identities? Haha! They remind me of someone else I know!)
(They couldn't talk to me directly, so they wrote letters. Hehe, they're so cute!)
(It's almost time for the interview. Should I go in?)
(Oops, I have something to do first! I'll finish it up fast and come back.)
(I'll give some really fun answers in case any of the kids see it!)
(Hm, why is she being so pushy?)
(I'll just tell her, "Okay, thanks, Ayako! I'm off to work now. Talk later! Love, Haruka.")
(It's a relief to hear everything's all right back home. That last message was weird, though.)
(Uh-oh! It's time for the interview! I better hurry to the Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall studio.)
(Yay, I don't have to worry! Of course, I don't want them to worry about me, now...)
(Let's see. "No, thanks, I'm good on goya! Soon I'm going to do an interview for a tourism mag. Maybe you'll all get to read it!")
(That'll get them excited!)
(Can't wait to see how they react.)
(Come on, Ayako! Why are you taking so long to write back?)
(Oh, here we go!)
(Aw, they're all watching me on TV? That's so nice! It makes me happy, even though it's kind of embarrassing!)
(I'd better write back... "I'm so glad to hear from you! Is everything okay back home?")
(Oh, she answered back already! She's getting good at this email thing.)
(I wonder how everyone's doing back home?)
(I miss it... Oh, that's right! Yamaura-san said I have an interview with an Okinawa tourism magazine. I've been so busy, I nearly forgot!)
(Oh, I got an email.)
(That's a big crowd... I wonder what's going on over there?)
(That's Miss Yamaura! What's she doing here?)
(Oh, and there's Ayu Kurata!)
(She must be doing a report on those street performers.)

Wow! You're a fantastic dancer! Are you hopin' to go pro
someday?

You bet! I can dance, and I can sing, too! I'm working
hard toward making my debut!

Oh, I'm sure you can do it! I bet you'll be a big star
someday! Good luck to you!
And cut! Okay, everybody, take five.
Phew. This is exhausting.

(Miss Yamaura's old partner, huh? If I want to talk to her,
this might be my only chance.)

(Okay, this could be what Miyu-chan is looking for.
Saida-san needs to hear this.)
(That's where the magazine interview is.)

(This is the Shofuku Sotenbori Building. I should see how
Nanako's doing.)

合計数値が22以上になるとBURSTとなり、
無条件で負けとなってしまうので
気を気をつけて下さい。

TOTALという数値が、
今のあなたの手札の合計値です。

合計値が11以下のとき、
BURSTすることはあり得ません。
カードを引く選択を選んでみましょう。

これ以上カードをもらうと
21を超えてしまいそうだと感じたら
STANDしましょう。
HITを選択すると、1枚カードを引きます。

DOUBLEDOWNも1枚カードをひきますが
引いた後の数字が必ず勝負しなければなりません。
BET額を2倍にできます。
Welcome to the blackjack table. Let's start with a tutorial on how to play. It will include three practice games that will help you learn.
The point of blackjack is to make the sum of your cards as close to 21 as possible.
If your cards add up to 22 or more, you automatically lose. This is called busting.
The "Total" you see here displays the total of the cards you currently have.
When your total is 11 or less, it's impossible to bust, so you should always draw an additional card.
Selecting "Hit" will draw a card.
Double Down will also draw a card, but you'll have to play with the cards in your hand at that point. You can also double your bet.
Draw one more card by selecting Hit or Double Down.
If you think you may go over 21 if you draw another card, select "Stand" to stay at your current total.
It's your turn. Oh, it looks like you have two Queens. All face cards have a value of 10.
When you have two cards of the same value, you can perform a split. Try selecting Split now.
Splitting allows you to separate your cards into two hands that you can play simultaneously. The value of the bet also doubles.
The result of your game will be reflected in the chip count, as you see here.
The dealer's open card is an ace. If the second one is a 10, Jack, Queen, or King, he has blackjack.
You'll most likely lose if the dealer gets blackjack, but you can lower your risk by setting half the bet amount as insurance.
Let's try using insurance this time.
If your insurance bet succeeds, you'll make your original bet back.
Otherwise, the round will continue as normal.
If you decide you have little or no chance of winning, you can select Surrender to retire from the game, losing only half the amount you bet.
One more rule. If you get six cards in your hand without busting, you get what is called a Six Card Charlie and win automatically.
This concludes our tutorial. Please enjoy playing all the games of skill and chance our casino has to offer!
Select Bet to set the number of chips to wager.
Let's play the second game. Select Bet or Re-bet and then set the number of chips to wager.
This is the final game in the tutorial. Select Bet or Re-bet, then set the number of chips to wager.
I'll teach you the rules of Pineapple Hold 'em, a variation of Texas Hold 'em, as we play.
Texas Hold 'em is a poker game in which you build five-card hands from two hole cards⑬your own cards⑬and five community cards.
In Pineapple Hold 'em, you are dealt three cards instead of two, but you must discard one of them.
This rule does not exist in regular Texas Hold 'em.
Let's see how things develop⑬select Check to end your turn.
All players have bet the same amount, so the game continues to the next round.
Community cards are dealt in the second round.
Notice how there is a card of the same rank in your own cards and in the community cards. That means you have one pair at this point.
The player to your right has selected Bet and increased the wager. He may have a good hand.
If you think you have a good hand, select Raise. Or, you can select Call to bet the same as the previous player. (Fold is currently disabled.)
This is the third round. A new community card has been dealt.
However, you still only have one pair.
At this point, you could select Fold to drop out if you didn't like your cards.
But it would be a shame to waste your pair, so let's stay in the game. (Fold is currently disabled.)
This is the final round. All community cards have been dealt.
Notice how you have another pair. That makes two pair in your hand. Let's heat things up by selecting Raise.
Congratulations! You have the stronger hand, which means you win all the chips that were bet in the current game.
Remember, select Bet or Raise when you think you have a good hand, and Check or Call when you want to assess the situation. If you'd rather retire, select Fold.
This concludes the practice round. Please enjoy playing all the games of skill and chance our casino has to offer!
Welcome to the baccarat table. I'll explain the rules for Super 6 baccarat while you play.
Baccarat is basically a game in which you bet on whether the player or the banker will win by getting the closest to 9.
There are six spots on which you can bet. For now, try betting on either the banker or the player.
Select whether you think the player or the banker will win.
Select a wager between the minimum and maximum betting limit. Use ○ to change your bet.
Use <Action:Button_RS_Up@Baccarat><Action:Button_RS_Down@Baccarat> to turn over the second card of the side you bet on. Go ahead.
If either the player or banker has an 8 or 9 (a natural), the winner is decided at that point.
A winning bet on the player pays 1:1, while a winning bet on the banker pays 0.95:1.
You can also bet that the player and banker will tie, and if you're right, the payout will be 8:1.
Now, let's bet on a pair. This means you think that the numbers of the first cards dealt will be the same.
Select whether you think the player or the banker will get a pair.
When you bet on a player pair, you're guessing that the first two cards dealt to the player will be the same number.
When you bet on a banker pair, you're guessing that the first two cards dealt to the banker will be the same number.
This time, try betting on which one will get a pair.
When you bet on a pair, the game is decided as soon as the first two cards of each side are opened.
A win pays 11:1.
Last but not least, I'll explain how to bet on Super 6 baccarat. The best way to learn is by playing, so let's place a practice bet.
Start by selecting Super 6.
Super 6 refers to the banker beating the player with a 6.
A winning bet pays up to 12:1, but the payout is only 0.5:1 if you bet on the banker when a Super 6 results.
I'll teach you the rules of Omaha Hold 'em, a variation of Texas Hold 'em, as we play.
Omaha Hold 'em is basically the same as regular Texas Hold 'em, except you are dealt four cards instead of two.
You then try to make the best hand you can with your own four cards and the five community cards.
At the end of the game, you must use two of your own cards and three of the community cards to create a hand.
Notice how you have two fives. That means you have one pair in your hand.
This is the third round. A new community card has been dealt. You now have another pair. This time, two fours. That means you have two pair in your hand.
This is the final round. All the cards have now been dealt. The last card dealt was a five. You must now make a hand with two of your own cards and three of the community cards.
It looks like you have a full house. Let's heat things up by selecting Raise.
Cold, isn't it? Come near the fire and warm up.
The road just re-opened, and they're selling gasoline again. What a relief, huh?
What was your name? Saejima-san? And the other fellow is Baba-san, right?
Don't look surprised. News gets around fast in a small community like this.
Come on, warm your hands near the fire. It's too frigging cold to do anything else.
You're not from around here, are you? Are you a tourist?
Not much to tour here. Except for the mountain! Last tour of your life, that might be.
Never thought I'd have to be rescued by anyone. I'm getting old.
I'm just glad yer safe. You're like a mentor to me, Okudera-han.
Let's eat. Baba there must be hungry.
This is... good, I think. It's not as gamey as I thought it would be. Yep, yep, tasty. Real tasty.
Can't say I like it myself... Just tastes lean and dry. But that's rabbit for ya.
I feel like it's making my strength return, at least.
Seems you're well on the way to recovery, Baba.

Yes. I... I really want to thank you both. For everything. I'm very
grateful.
Saejima, good news about your cold weather clothes. I used the rabbit's skin to patch them up. Would you like to try them on?
Real warm. Downright cozy.
That'll slow down your energy loss on the mountain.
Thank you, Okudera-han.
You got Special Cold Wear.
Don't thank me. You're the one who caught the rabbit, and risked your life to do so.
Hmph, modest as always.
Heh. That's for sure.
So be it, then.
Where ya goin' now?
To check on the village. I want to see if the road is still closed from the snow.
